notes.title: Sunwave Hotel Has Left Early Access!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, 

This update is the culmination of a lot of bugfixing, rebuilding the Gallery, and preparing the Achievements for players to unlock and enjoy. It's been a helluva ride to get to this point in the game's development and I'm happy to share it with fans, old and new.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gallery Update[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The gallery has been completely redone. Twice. It is now accessed in-game by simply clicking on the Gallery button at the top right of the screen. From there, you will be taken to the first page of the gallery.[/p][p][/p][p]The scenes are now set to unlock as you progress through them by playing the game and encountering the characters and scenes during your adventure. However, if you have already unlocked most scenes or just want to to skip to the lewd content, there is a Gallery Unlocker function in the first page of the gallery[/p][p]
[b]Concerning Achievements[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Sunwave Hotel has 14 achievements for you to unlock. For returning players, a few may get activated when you play the game if you knocked out the requirements before, but most of them have been tweaked and edited because there were changes that needed to be made. But all of them should work as designed, went through and tested them myself.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Steam Summer Sale[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The game is also going to be 30% Off during the Steam Summer Sale, June 26 - July 10.[/p][p][/p][p]And that's about it for everything about the update. Thanks as always for your support on this journey. It's been a wild ride and I hope you're excited for what comes next from our team.[/p][p][/p][p]-Wildquill[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel v14.17a - The Final Fixings
notes.content:
The new Sunwave Hotel update is here!

Enjoy plenty of spicy new content with 6 new scenes, 67 enticing CG images, and over 9615 words added to our quirky island adventure.

Anyone who is ready for a taste should jump right in. For anyone who wants to know a little bit about the content, read on.

This update includes the final scene additions to 4 characters. Kuhno, Corsoni, Omi and Olera.

[b]Kuhno[/b]
Kuhno's content starts off right near the end of the main adventure, so you can finally spend some time reconnecting with your companion. The final of her 3 scenes is her vacation section that includes pregnant variations for those who want to add something extra to the adventure.

[b]Corsoni[/b]
Our lovely woflgirl finally has her Mega Scene in the game, along with her Vacation Section at the end. I won't spoil more than that, apart from saying we made sure that Corsoni can have the same kind of fun as we mentioned for Kuhno above.

[b]Omi and Olera[/b]
The lovely sharkgirls need a favor, and they're not hesitant about being a little bratty to get what they want. It's finally time to reap your rewards with the sexy aquatic ladies.

This is very likely the final story content update for Sunwave Hotel. I am already concepting the next tech update to make us compatible with Steamdecks, and we're also starting to work on Cards and Achievements for anyone who is interested in those.

I've mentioned this before, but just to make sure everyone knows, this is not the last game coming from our group. I learned a whole lot during Sunwave Hotel and I'm already putting those lessons into two new projects. I'll share more about those in the coming months so enjoy this new update and stay tuned.

notes.title: Shark Attack - Da Duh Dun!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Hope you're having a good week and a good April. My apologies for being a bit quiet lately. March came and went like a storm, and now we're here in the 4th month of 2025. Holy shit. On the plus side, I've been working steadily with the artists and cracking into the writing to create the next big content update.

It will probably not be the last content update but we are certainly getting there. This new update will feature 3 scenes with Kuhno, 2 scenes for Corsoni, and 1 final scene for our lovely shark girls Omi and Olera.

Additionally, I got a huge list of bugs to fix so I'm going to be cracking through as many of those as I can fix and nip in the butt before putting out the new update.

[b]Release Window[/b]

Expect the update to come out on Steam near the weekend.

As I said, we're kind of getting to the finish line for Sunwave Hotel. I'll be sure to make a big post kind of going over the entire adventure, such as it is, maybe in May or so.

Naturally, this will not be my last naughty game. I'm already working on 2 new projects. I'm not 100 percent sure on how the rules go, but I'm sure I'll be able to make some connecting post or something when there is something to share. That way, anyone who is a fan of my style of games will be alerted to the new adventures coming out in 2025 and 2026.

While she may always be looking for shortcuts, this wily Yokaru is ready to settle down with someone who gets her, warts and all.

[b]Looking Ahead[/b]

Vynore has one more scene to go, her special ending scene. Then it will be full steam ahead on Corsoni's mega and ending scene, along with some of the final parts for Kuhno. Thank you for all your support, and have a great week

WQ

notes.title: Update News
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Sorry that things have been a little quiet. In the new year, January hit me like a train and then kind of ran me over a few times for good measure. But now things are back on schedule, and the next update is nearly here. All the writing is done, and we just need to have some of the final code mechanics fixed up, so I expect that the next update will come out in the middle of next week or early on the week starting on Feb 17.

As to the content, I've posted a bit of a preview teaser right here in this post. Vynore has a special outfit that she wants to share with you. This is but one part of Vynore's mega scene, the penultimate encounter with our sexy Yokaru troublemaker.

I hope everyone will find something in this scene to enjoy. It even has unique pregnancy content and another fetish that I will announce when the update is ready.

Once the mega scene is out, the only thing left for Vynore is her ending content, her own special vacation with the main character. All of the art for that scene is already complete, so I am hopeful that we will have a second update in late February that helps wrap up everything with Vynore.

After that, my focus will return to Corsoni, some special Kuhno content, and a few other odds and ends to finish up all the content for Sunwave Hotel. Of course once that is done, we'll be looking to grind down any edges and remove any bugs, but it will still feel good having all the content plugged into the game so it can be enjoyed by the fans.

And I think that is it for now. Thanks for stopping by, and have a great rest of your weekend.

notes.title: Happy Holidays - December 2024
notes.content:
Merry Xmas everyone!

What a crazy year it's been. I hope that everyone has gotten to enjoy themselves this month. I myself got a cold that lasted from pretty much Thanksgiving to a few days ago. On the plus side, I managed to put together a lot of art of the next major update but we also have this little small update to prepare for the new year.

No new story content has been added but I have added the beginning of a new mode to play the game. Some users have requested a Visual Novel mode for Sunwave Hotel to have a more straight-forward playstyle and not the regular sandbox mode.

So far the Visual Novel mode covers about half of the first island. This is kind of a demo within the game and I'll be looking for feedback from people to see if it is worth it to make the VN style available to the entire ride.

In January, there will be a new content update that adds more story for Kuhno, Zatanka, and Vynore, hopefully, so make sure to stick around to see the end of their stories as we prepare to put the final stamp on this tropical adventure.

Thank you again to everyone who has purchased and followed Sunwave Hotel. This second year has given me a lot of lessons, and I wouldn't have made it without your support.

Happy Holidays

-Wildquill

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel 14.15e A Zatanka Special
notes.content:
Sunwave Hotel v14.15e is here!

[b]Zatanka Content[/b]

This new update includes the full Zatanka Mega Scene, which includes more focus on breeding up our favorite Ortheon. The full scene has several separate parts that even include optional fetish content for those who want to try it out.

Then, once the main quest is completed, you can check out her special vacation scene, which is teased in the middle of this mission.

[b]Omi and Olera[/b]

Beyond the Zatanka scene, this update also includes some more content with Olera and Omi as they try to navigate their lives as daughters of Ooli, the crime lord in charge of the Smuggling Cartel. If you play your cards right, you can find a new scene with them.]

[b]Perluun Content[/b]

Lastly, we've spent some time tweaking Perluun's story content. Her third scene has been completely rewritten from the ground up. We're interested to hear what people think of her enchanted content.

[u]Technical Details[/u]

This update has 14639 words and 68 new renders. The amount of scenes in the game is now up to 75!

[b]Known Issue[/b]

If you change the Preg or Mode 1 or Mode 2 Switch in the menu, you need to move to a different location in the game for this change to take effect.

If you encounter bugs, spelling errors, or lockups, please post in the Community Error Discussion area, and I will go in and fix the issue.

[b]Looking Ahead
[/b]
We will add a bit more of Zatanka's story content in December. Vynore is also getting her mega scene too, we just completed the first part of the scene. Kuhno will also get some pregnancy content, and Corsoni's mega scene just needs to be written to be uploaded.

Beyond that, I'm looking at the various side characters who deserve to have one final part of their story. Let me know who you think needs a final sendoff as I work to tie up the loose ends for Sunwave Hotel.

[b]Thank you, and have a great weekend![/b]

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel 14.15d At Journey's End
notes.content:
It is finally here. [b]The end of the main quest storyline[/b] is now a part of the game.

IMPORTANT! This does not mean Sunwave Hotel is done. It is still going to be updated with game polish and fixes to earlier content. Even some bust art will probably be tweaked in the future.

I will not get into spoilers about the ending, but after many months of trying to lock it in, it feels great having it put together, and I hope people will enjoy it. I'll probably post my thoughts in a few weeks once people who want to play it have gone through it to review certain things and answer any questions people have.

The update is mostly focused on the main story. It's got the final two main quests for the storyline. It also has a bunch of Action Cutscene Art for the final part. Really love how those came out.

Lastly, this update will also give players the option to start on the Zatanka Impregnation Storyline. Her route for this Kink is kind of like a test ground for how it should be applied to the companions. If you're a fan of Pregnancy and have thoughts on how the content is setup so far, please let me know what you think.
[b]
Known Issues[/b]

I recommend making regular saves to avoid getting locked up in bad spots. If you do encounter a point where your game is just locked and you can't go forward, please report it here or in the Discord.
Do not travel back to Lowoswah from Island 2. This travel option is bugged and will be worked out this week.

Bug Fix and Content Update hopefully to come in late October early November.

notes.content:
2024, where did you go? It's already Labor Day, holy cow!

If you're around me, hopefully, you're enjoying a day off. If not, I hope you have a fun Monday and things aren't too crazy.

August was a heavy work month and September is going to be much the same, with a major difference. As we enter September, I am happy to report that all the major parts of the ending for Sunwave Hotel have been written out. 

WARNING! DANGER!

The section below could be considered minor spoilers. I won't go into the stories and content, but I will talk about the theme of the content. So if you want stay clear, get out now and have a great week!

Okay, let's continue.

The only part remaining to write about is the vacations for companions.

I call them vacations and not endings because they're part of one of the endings that you can choose at the end of SH. These stories will give you some time to focus on your favorite companion  (or companions) and make a big decision with them as well. The plan is for these decisions to play out in future content set in the Sunwave Hotel universe.

Anyhow, that's about all I have today. Back to chilling (and a little writing. We're working on new dev build to test out the ending. 

Cheers!

notes.title: More Zatanka is just more Orc Girl to love
notes.content:
I'm deep into the work on the new game update for Sunwave Hotel. It's going to have a boatload of new content, some of which will focus on our lovely green lady here.

I'm very happy to show off Zatanka's outfit for Island 3. It won't be fully implemented in the next update, but it should come in the following update. It won't just be a new casual look. We will see Zatanka in 7 different looks, including a couple for if you decide to go down her 'Family' Path :p

I'm very happy with how the design came out. It still retains her gym clothes aesthetic. The shock baton on her back gives a new edginess, and as always, we kept her abs front and center, both in this final look and other designs.

Thanks to all current Early Access members for your patience with this new update.  The end of the story is in sight, and I think there is always that impulse just to take a moment and redo this or edit that, but it is being built one step at a time, slowly but surely.

This next update will not contain the conclusion to the main story, but it definitely sets up the final act, and I hope you will all enjoy it. We'll also have another scene with the foxgirl Jade and the merc Merrik and some new fun on the beach with a couple of threesome scenes.

And that's all I got for you right now. I hope you have a good week. The next time I'll be around here, it will be with a special Game Update delivery.

Cheers!

Be seeing you.

notes.title: Xun is going to have his hands full
notes.content:
Welcome one and all to the first post for April! March got a little busy and a little quiet, mostly because I got sick around last Thursday and now we're a week in. Nothing too bad, thankfully, just cough and runny nose. I think I'm close to kicking it to the curb, but we'll see. 

On the plus side, we got some new assets for Vynore in March. The lovely Yokaru is all ready for motherhood (just don't tell her I said that). Once we get to that point in her story content, we have a variety of very delicious looks for her. Wanted to show off a couple so I put her in with Corsoni who was the first to have a full set of renders for when if she goes the MILF path.

I'm very happy with how they are looking, and I can't wait to have renders made for the rest of the main companions, and Kuhno, of course.

The next game update is cooking, some days are better than others but I always try to add a few sentences here and there to make sure that even when I'm feeling low, I know I've always moved the dial a bit.

The release window for the next update should be sometime in May. It will have more of the main quest as that has become pretty much my focus of late, along with some more companion story content, most likely for Zatanka and Corsoni, maybe even a little for Vynore. And that's about it.

Have a great rest of your week!

Wildquill

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel 14.13.1 is nearly here
notes.content:
Hello. everyone. I hope you're having a good week and are ready for the weekend.

Just stopping by to go over the next update. All of the writing and art production for the new update is complete. I am sorry that I couldn't sneak it in for February. It will be available this coming week. The plan is to put out the update and then do a small vacation in Vegas. I haven't been there since before the 
pandemic so I'm really excited to get out there and also refresh my batteries a bit.

The Framework of the new Update
The Main Quest continues. (I'll try to keep this spoiler free)

On Island 3, you have your work cut out for you. It's not simply a matter of revenge, you need to find someone important and unlike Island 2, there are no friendly factions looking to help you out. This new main quest will introduce some new allies and enemies for you to contend with. Be prepared for anything.

Character Scenes involving Corsoni and Zatanka.
Both Corsoni and Zatanka are going through some rough times. These new quests will help pull back the curtain and reveal more about each character, while also providing you plenty of opportunities to get closer to them.

2 brand new scenes are coming.
The images tease a bit of what Vynore will be up to, but there will also be a new scene coming for Tengot, our sexy corpo agent.

And that is the long and short of it. Have a great weekend and cheers to all of you who have joined us on our journey here.

notes.title: Progress Report
notes.content:
So January is already done. Holy cow. Luckily, while it felt like a quick month, it was also a very busy month.

The main quest production is now going along a lot more smoothly. Even better than that, I have two writers showing off their skills and helping me to grow the storylines of Corsoni and Zatanka. These new story events should help grow both of the characters and give players more meaningful choices if they want to stay in relationships with them.

This will be repeated with Perluun and Vynore, but for now, we're focused on our tomboy orc girl and are gothy wolfgirl.

In addition to the writing side, I am testing out a few new artists for character sprites and new scenes. If they work out, this will only help our production speed in the future as we work to reach the planned ending for Sunwave Hotel.

The next game update should come out sometime in February and will add new story content and a couple of new spicy scenes for people to enjoy. The images attached are all from Corsoni's mega scene, the largest scene produced for Sunwave Hotel. It is a real gem of a scene, and I can't wait to share more.

Once the main parts of the scene are finished, it will get Pregnancy Variations so that it can be used if you have Pregnancy Mode on. Beyond that, I am also planning to get it animated as well. Like I said, it's a mega scene.

And that is pretty much it. Lots of writing and drawing are going on, and the next update will be coming near the end of the month.

Cheers to you all, and thanks for stopping by.

notes.title: Happy New Year 2024
notes.content:
I'm sure you can all see that this post is a little tardy. I got sick days before New Year, and while it wasn't anything crazy, I was pretty much laid out and just wallowing in bed or on the couch, even on the night the ball dropped.

But I'm back in the saddle and ready to kick some ass. First things first, the main quest for Sunwave Hotel is getting its ass kicked into gear. I don't want to talk much into spoiler territory, but once this block of events it out of the way, it will be a much easier path going forward.

[u][b]Other Writing[/b][/u]

Beyond the main quest, I am looking to expand the writing team so that we can do more character-focused content. I love writing and always will, but as the game has grown in scale, I've felt the need to expand the team in ways I didn't predict.

Luckily, we've had some solid writers working on the project; some even contributed to scenes in the last update, and it seemed like everything went pretty smoothly with their content. 

I'm looking to give us more focus on Corsoni and Zatanka in the near future, with Vynore and Perluun following behind.

[u][b]Artwork[/b][/u]

We've got a steady supply of amazing artwork coming out. The biggest art of it is a multi-position scene with Corsoni. It will feature some cute setup, a blowjob, footjob, vaginal sex and some anal pounding. The best part is that it will be constructed in a way to that people can go through the scene as they see fit so if a part of it is not for you, then you can just skip on to the next thing you'd like.

It's the biggest scene that we have made yet, but I believe it will speak for itself when it's plugged into the game.

[u][b]Voice Work[/b][/u]

I think that while we continue adding more voice lines to Kuhno scenes, I will start looking for 1-2 voice actors to give us some voice work for Zatanka and Corsoni as well. Like everything, we won't be leaving Perluun and Vynore behind, this will just be the jumping-off point.

The next update should be out in February to March. Have a great rest of your week. I look forward to sharing much more Sunwave Hotel content with all of you this year.

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel 14.12.2 is out!
notes.content:
[b]New Erotic Scenes[/b]

Special Reward with Triss after her interview. The pluck reporter from Island 2 finally gets to interview you. Her scene can play out in one of two ways depending on if you take the dom path or the sub path.
Special Date Night with Omi and Olera. The Shark Twins are excited to repay you for your rescue. This scene occurs at the conclusion of the Smuggler's Faction, so if you haven't played through it already, this is a great time to start.
4 Scenes added to the Main Gallery that you can access in the Main Menu.
2 new Selfie Scenes added. One for Zatanka and one for Vynore.

[b]Story Events[/b]

Spend some time with Omi and Olera. The daughters of the cartel boss have been through a lot and their place on Onakinii is uncertain.
Talk to Vynore on Island 1 to learn more about her backstory and why she came to the islands.
Zatanka is in the mood to work out. The spunky Ortheon wants to be your personal trainer and if you agree, she may have a special prize for you.
Overview

Over 18k new words added to this update.
2 new erotics scenes.
2 naughty selfies.
Fixing up the intros and backstories for some of the main companions.

P.S. I think we have a broken background for Omi and Olera's Date night. Will work to replace that shortly.

notes.title: Small News on Key Features
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Heading into the weekend here so I wanted to make sure to put out a small update. I'm happy to report that this month the coder has been hard at work building in a proper Back Button function in the game.

This will allow players to rewind things if they end up making a choice during a dialogue that they don't enjoy, or if they run into other issues.

Beyond the button, we have also been working to allow players to Save during conversations and to Load back into those points. This will allow for more freedom and allow players to save at any point during the game if life interferes as it often does.

Anyhow, like I said this is a small post but it is big news for those who have been waiting for these features. We are confident that they will be part of the next update.

They work, but they're a little imprecise so we still have a little bit of tweaking to go. I have also been hard at work outlining the new quests and scenes that I want to build for the final update of 2023.

Stay tuned and have a great weekend.

WQ

notes.title: Happy Halloween from Sunwave Hotel!
notes.content:
Trick or Treat!

Wishing everyone a fun and spooky night this Halloween. October has been a whirlwind for Sunwave Hotel and I can't wait to see how things go for the remainder of the year.

The coder is working on adding more functions to polish up gameplay and I've been working on organizing new scene art while also locking down to write the next main quest section for Xun and Kuhno's adventure.

Next major game update should come around late November or Early December.

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel v14.12
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

It's strange I thought I made a post when I was uploading the new build but I guess not.

Hey just here to say that the game has been updated again with another small bug fix to patch some more of the rough spots. Keep those bug reports coming. I'm always looking to improve and polish up the game.

[u]Specifics[/u]
The Back Button during scenes should now be fully functional now. We're also looking into adding a regular Back Button for during conversations.
Improved Adoka Conversation. This is when you're talking to her and getting to know her better.
Day Counter is now in the Status Menu, not just on the screen.

[u]Future Fixes[/u]
Dedicated Back Button
Graphic Scaling - Apparently, this is an issue for some users.
Fixing Mac Save Bug - There is a Mac build for the game but we haven't been able to fix a save bug issue.
Saving during conversations
Journal and Codex. Something to keep track of your progress on the Main Quest, and something to give players more lore for the species and world of Sunwave Hotel.
Fix issues with Kuhno Conversation in the Guest House.
Improve dialogue for your first meeting with Kaci to clarify what she is talking about and ensure it's easy to get to her scene or skip it if you don't like it.

notes.title: Watch your back out there
notes.content:
[b]Hello Outlaws[/b]

This week has been a whirlwind. I've been delighted to meet many of you who picked up Sunwave Hotel and gave me some feedback. We've already got our first bugfix update out, hopefully further improving the game while we're still in the first month of Early Access.

As a special treat, I wanted to show off a trio of lovely ladies who will have an impact on the next big update to the story of Sunwave Hotel.

From left to right, we have Keylan, Badyrii, and Firah. I'm really happy with how their designs came out, and I can't wait to introduce them to players as the story of Island 3 continues to unfold.

[b]v14.11 Patchnotes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a lot of dead ends that might lock up your progression in the game.
[*] Fixed a list of typos along with some issues where the Player's Custom Name was not showing.
[/list]

If you run into bugs or broken issues, please drop a note in the Community Hub Bug Reporting Section or come over to the Discord Server and drop a line there.

[b]General Thoughts[/b]

It's kind of surreal thinking about how the game has only been out since this Monday. It feels like it's almost been a month. The reception has been great, way better than I expected, and I want to thank each and every one of you who has picked up the game during Early Access. It's already going to make a huge impact on development and has also been the biggest endorsement that I have been working on crafting something cool for people to dig into after a long day.

And we're just getting started!

Have a great weekend.

Wildquill

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel is here! FAQ
notes.content:
[b]The Future of Sunwave Hotel[/b]

Hello,

This has been a long time coming, and I'm so happy to have Sunwave Hotel out on Steam. We've been around for a couple of years now, but this is the biggest step we've made. I hope that all of you will find something special in Sunwave Hotel. It has been a labor of love and we're not done yet.

[u][b]Technical Advice[/b][/u]

Save often. The game has some bumps and bruises that we're working hard to fix up. I recommend saving often just in case you run into a bad room bug. This just means that a quest exits you out onto an old room file and traps you there. I'm working hard to nip all of these issues in the butt, but for now it doesn't hurt to have some backups.

I'm also looking at increasing the total amount of save files.

[b]Main plan for what comes next[/b]

Pretty much the number one priority is just finishing the main story. We're at 75 percent on that, so there isn't much to do and I'm confident it will all be finished and polished in 2024. Beyond just the ending, we will have different endings for players to choose from based on their choices throughout the main story.

Improving Saving and Loading. Right now, you can only save after events, and you can't load from in-game. We are working to add that functionality so people can do as many routes as possible.

[b]Gallery Information[/b]

We have begun construction of a proper Gallery for the game. You can find it in the Main Menu. It is not complete, but we have you covered if you want to review the juicy scenes. In the game, after you do the first mission, if you just go to the left of the town map, you will see a Not-So-Secret Gallery.


We created this early on so that in case of bugs, people can always check out the scenes. Our plan is to convert the old gallery into a new gallery. I will be working on this throughout October. It will be a long process, but worth it once all the pieces are in the right place.

[b]Achievements[/b]

Achievements are on the list, and I expect to work out the coding side to achieve them during October or November. I know this may frustrate some, but Sunwave Hotel is still being finished, and I didn't really want to jump into making achievements until everything was in place.

But rest assured, in the future, Sunwave Hotel will have a range of achievements for people to unlock, after we make sure the system works properly.

[b]Plans for Voice[/b]

We have experimented with Voice Acting during the development, and I can see just how much it adds to the game. We already have a voice actor for Kuhno, and we will continue expanding this function in the future. It can feel a bit 'extra', but when Kuhno's voice pops in with an animated scene, it really elevates things to the next level.

[b]Plans for Animations[/b]

With enough support, the plan is to get at least 50 percent of the scenes animated. Nothing is better than watching the 2d pieces come to life.

[b]Additional Content[/b]

Beyond finishing the main quest, we will see a large Side Quest being added to Sunwave Hotel in the future as well. Everything is plotted out. It's just a matter of writing the content and manufacturing the scenes.

We're also planning to do a Female Protagonist option in the future as well. Kuhno will be turned into a Playable Character so that people can play as a male or a female character.

Naturally, we have plenty of room to expand. New islands, new characters, this is just the start of a new galaxy.

[b]Additional Languages[/b]

During September, the team was hard at work making sure that in the future, the system can cover special characters for other languages. We don't have any concrete plans for what comes next, but we are definitely open to adding additional language support during the development cycle.

If you have any other questions, drop them here or in the Steam Community Section.

notes.title: Quality Improvements - Backgrounds and Gallery
notes.content:
[b]Early Access[/b] is a few weeks away. This is crazy! I am thrilled to thank each and every one of you who has supported this game and all of the new people wishlisting it. I think we're actually now visible on STEAM's 
 Popular Upcoming list, which is a huge feat for me.

Anyhow, onto the nitty-gritty of the post.

Been working on polishing up systems and figuring out the essential list for Early Access. For any who don't know, the story will not be completed upon Early Access, but the story will take you to the final island of the game, essentially the third act. The story and where it goes are all plotted out; it's just a matter of forging it and making sure the conclusion and endings have the punch I want it to have.

Taking the time with the ending has allowed me to spend some time cleaning up earlier parts of the game, like Island 1. My style of production / scripting and just everything has changed a lot so Island 1 definitely has many areas to fix up. One of those points has been the background art. With such a small team and limited resources, I just made basic art for the backgrounds when we started. You can see an example above.

Thankfully, now with grit and support, we have some really amazing hand-drawn backgrounds for players to enjoy and make the world of Sunwave Hotel pop with much more vibrancy. I'll always enjoy the old basic ones, but when SH is complete, all the backgrounds will have a much more polished state.

[b]Gallery [/b]

For anyone who has already played one of the free versions, you know that the gallery is in a not-so-secret place just off the main town. Obviously, that is not going to be a permanent thing going forward. I have just sent word to the coder to set to work on making the Gallery part of the Main Menu. At some point during Early Access, the gallery will also work like a normal game gallery, with the content unlocking as you unlock scenes in game.

For the moment, all the scenes will be available for people to check out and enjoy all the scenes. I made this call early on so that in case there is a bug/broken path, players can still always see the juicy scenes if they want.

And I think that's all I have for today. Thanks for reading.

[b]TLDR[/b]
Old Background Art is being vastly improved upon and work has started on turning the not-so-secret Gallery into a proper H-Game Gallery.

Enjoy the rest of your week.

notes.title: Secult - The Fluffiest
notes.content:
Continuing with companions from the second island, we have this blonde beauty. Secult.

You meet her early on during your adventures on Onakinii Island. Secult is as good with computers as she is bad at going out. Fortunately, the shut-in is happy to help you take down a powerful threat, not only to you but to the entire island.

Beyond her skills with all things code and more, Secult can develop a very special affinity towards you if you play your cards right. There is nothing that the shut-in likes more than some 'play time' after a job is complete.

Consider her the opposite to Nyras. The bunnygirl is harsh and uncompromising, whereas this lovely neko is playful, boisterous and very eager to know about you (and what you might do to her).

You'll be able to meet both Secult and Nyras and many more characters when Sunwave Hotel enters Early Access in October, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Nyras - The Bunnygirl Exile and 8000 Milestone!
notes.content:
You arrive on Onakinii Island (Island 2) after a dangerous trip and a hard landing. You've lost track of your friend Turges and whichever companion you chose to bring with you. Things look tough but then a new ally puts you in touch with Nyras, a mysterious operative with an axe to grind. 

Nyras has many secrets, but little by little you can learn more about her and even help her on the mission that brought her to the islands.

She is sharp-tongued, rational, and more than a little edgy. If Nyras has a soft side, it very rarely peaks its head out, but if you're interested, stick around and help her where you can. Nyras might just surprise you.

[b]Side Note[/b]

Sunwave Hotel has now broken 8000 Wishlisters. We had a tremendous July and I'm really hoping we can finish off the Summer strong! I just wanted to give a special shoutout to everyone who has been following me since the start and welcome everyone who has joined us recently. Watching the numbers increase, it really just is unreal and I cannot wait to get the Early Access build ready and into the hands of anyone who wants to dive into the wonderful world of Sunwave Hotel.

notes.title: The Corpo
notes.content:
Tengot slides into your life right after the Dream Master steals your boss' credits. She is the first potential 'ally' on Onakinii Island and like all the agents of the megacorps on the second island, she is not to be trifled with.

One of the first things she will press you on is information, because like everything else on the island, knowledge has power and power can be sold like everything else.

By backing Orcis Operations, you'll not only get a very well funded patron, but a sexy one as well. So far Tengot has two scenes in the game (including one pregnant variation).

Her story is not complete yet, but I can safely say she will offer you the deal of the century before your time together is over.

[b]Side Note[/b]

I am happy to say that Sunwave Hotel will be presented at the GWDC Contest in July. We probably won't be taking home any awards because there are already some truly amazing pieces posted there. But I'm still excited because it just means more people will catch a glimpse of the game and will help build the audience that little bit more.

notes.title: A sign of things to come
notes.content:
[url=https://imgur.com/a/pQrsH0p]Animated and Voiced Preview[/url]

It's amazing how things suddenly kind of just click when you have animation+sounds. It takes an amazing scene and makes it incredible.

We started testing out some animation in April, and now it's starting to look like something we can work on each month. It would be amazing to have animated scenes for the scenes including Kuhno and main girls.

Will see how it goes.

Very happy with the two artists who created the image and the voice actress for spicing up the scene with Kuhno's soft "Mmmm" noises

Enjoy the rest of your week folks!

notes.title: Watch out for Semni
notes.content:
[b]Meet Semni[/b]

Semni comes to Lowoswah Island (the first island) by way of a tragic mistake. With no immediate way to fix the errors of her past, she focuses on her future, making her a potent agent for justice when she comes across you and Kuhno.

While her dogged mentality is an early obstacle for you to overcome, being the slick outlaw that you are, there is potential for you to learn more about the sexy beach warden as your adventure continues.

Semni is certainly a strong proponent of law and order, but she might have a few areas where she is willing to bend the rules if you prove to be the lesser of two evils.

That said, Semni still stands on the other side of the game, so be sure to stay frosty around her.

[u][b]Update Notes[/b][/u]

The March Update went well, and now the game is sitting on 57 scenes. Of even greater news is that one of our talented artists has started working on animating scenes. The first test is a new scene with Xera, a sexy racer. If all goes well, we will likely be getting 1-2 scenes animated a month. 

Have a great day, and if you haven't already, don't forget to wishlist the game. Every little bit goes a long way for us, and we've nearly broken 4000 wishlisters!

Everyone who supports us and follows us here or other places, you are amazing!

notes.title: Adoka and the mighty 3500!
notes.content:
[b]Meet Adoka[/b]

Adoka is a Mephalin (squidperson), one of the first faces you come across after arriving on the island chain. She runs the Blue Lagoon Bar and knows how to make a mean Mai Tai and many other specialty drinks. Be sure to check in with her often to help with quests but watch out that you keep work talk to a minimum.

Adoka is a free-spirited kind of gal and believes that conflicts can always be solved with a good drink and a chat. She’s never a fan of fighting or chaos unless the chaos is of the kinky variety.

When she’s not tending bar, you can sometimes find her working on her tan down by the beach.

[b]Progress Report[/b]

It's been a while since I talked about the game here. I need to get better about that. Good news first, we have broken well over 50 scenes in the game, each with unique art and writing. The story is coming along smoothly and we have now made it to the end of Island 2. That means that the road to Island 3 (the final planned) island is open.

I'm working on the story for that pretty much each day, but the first priority is finishing up some content for side characters. First on the list is Alexis, the researcher. I always planned to go back and add more to her story, and it's finally time for me to do that.

I am firm in my belief that the game will be at least in Early Access or completed before the end of 2023. As I noted, Island 3 is the last planned island. It will bring the story to an end, but if we want to, we can totally expend the endgame content with more sidequests and companion-based events.

That is about it. As you might have guessed, we have now hit 3500 Wishlisters, which is truly awesome to think about. I remember just how excited I got when we reached 1000, so this was great news when I saw it last week. Thanks to all of you who have added it, and I hope to make more posts like this as 2023 continues.

notes.title: Vynore
notes.content:
Vynore is a rebel without a cause. Well she's not even a rebel, unless you count rebels against working. Always up for taking a load off, this sexy Yokaru is constantly between jobs and looking for her next big break.

In Vynore's mind, there is nothing wrong with finding a good friend who will take care of all your needs, including those financial and physical. She's more than happy to leave the heavy lifting to Yokaru like her sister. If you asked her what she wanted to be when she grew up, she'd probably reply with one word.

Comfortable.

Will you lend her a hand and give her a roof over her head? Or will you stay clear of her talent for mooching?

notes.title: Perluun
notes.content:
Perluun is mysterious, even after you start getting to know her.  You meet the quiet woman listening to music and just enjoying a drink at the bar on the first island. Be sure to pay attention, and she might open up. 

The polite Moonelf has many secrets, and they’re weighing heavily on her mind. Will you help her, or is she too untrustworthy to rely on? If you join her path, just remember to be patient with her. Eventually, the truth will come out. In the meantime, she will look to you for comfort during this trying time in her life.

notes.title: Corsoni
notes.content:
Corsoni doesn't talk much about her past, but something has forever changed her outlook. She spends her days lazily bouncing back and forth between surfing and wandering the shores of Lowoswah Island. If you're the helpful and patient kind of person, she might open up, but it will be slow going.

While her backstory is a mystery, Corsoni wears her personality on her shoulder. Don't let her cold looks fool you, once you get her to warm up, this fluffy woman can really light up, and get a little aggressive later on as well. Her aimlessness might be your benefit because if you befriend the gothy surfer, you might get a friend (and more) for life.

notes.title: Zatanka
notes.content:
Zatanka was one of the top players of power tennis. Unfortunately, her temper got the better of her and she damaged her career during a championship bout. Because of her outbursts, the Ortheon woman was kicked out of the competition, but one of her friends holds out hope that they can get her back into the league.

While she waits for her friend to come through, Zatanka finds herself managing a gym on Lowoswah Island. Keeping seniors in shape is not what she expected to be doing during her best years, and she’s just about run out patience, until an interesting pair of people arrive.

notes.title: Kuhno
notes.content: Kuhno is a barbarian living among the stars. From a young age, she was taught the savage skills of her tribe before she left her homeworld to explore. As much as she’s adapted, Kuhno is still a quick-tempered warrior who believes in omens, both good and bad. She has been your companion for years, joining the syndicate when she decided you were fun enough to stick around. You two have been through good times and bad, but this new adventure may be your greatest test yet.

notes.title: Beginnings and Introductions
notes.content:
Nice of you to drop by. For any of you who don't know me, you can call me Wildquill. 
While [b]Sunwave Hotel[/b] will be my first solo project on [b]Steam[/b]. I've worked as a writer in the game industry for more than 6 years now, and I'm very excited to bring Sunwave Hotel to Steam.

The game covers the adventure of two outlaws who start out with a crashed spaceship and little resources. They have to work together to pick up the pieces and finish the job that brought them to a lush tropical paradise of a planet.

As beautiful and peaceful as the place looks, there are plenty of dangers and obstacles for our 'heroes' to tackle, and it will be up to each player just how they approach some of these. Right now, the game is about 20 percent complete, but the main story beats have been laid out a while ago.

I hope that some of you will join me on this epic adventure. Sunwave Hotel will be my first project as a Director, but it will not be my last. If you enjoy Sci-Fi Adventures with Adult Settings and Themes, then look no further.
